title: Class Templates
learningObjectives: Identify template parameters and required operations.
Design a reusable generic utility or type.

understand.concept: A class template defines a family of classes parameterized by types or compile-time values. Instantiating it creates a concrete type with members based on those parameters.
understand.whyItMatters: Reusable structures can support multiple element types without duplicating class code.
understand.explain: Read each class template as a type recipe. Identify members whose types depend on the parameter and instantiate with different types.

examples.title: Box class template
examples.code:
template<class T>struct Box{T value;};
Box<int> a{7};Box<std::string> b{\"hi\"};
examples.explanation: T determines the stored member type.

examples.title: Two type holder
examples.code:
template<class A,class B>struct Duo{A first;B second;};
Duo<int,double> d{1,2.5};
examples.explanation: A and B represent distinct member types.

examples.title: Default type
examples.code:
template<class T=int>struct Number{T value{};};
Number<> n;
examples.explanation: Default template argument can be omitted.

examples.title: Alias instantiation
examples.code:
template<class T>struct Store{T item;};
using IntStore=Store<int>;IntStore s{9};

examples.title: Generic list wrapper
examples.code:
template<class T>struct Mini{std::vector<T> values;void add(const T& x){values.push_back(x);}};
Mini<int> m;m.add(3);
examples.explanation: Template parameter is used by its vector member.

practise.guidedTask: Analyze each Class Templates example: identify parameters, requirements, deduced or explicit arguments, and instantiated behavior.
practise.independentTask: Write a generic C++ utility or type demonstrating class templates. Test two supported types, one boundary case, and one unsupported/constrained type; explain why it is or is not accepted.
hints: Begin with a concrete example before generalizing.
Name template parameters for their roles.

questions.explanation: Alias refers to a concrete template type.
